title: Add product images for all 50 Gorilla Tag cosmetic items

requirements.text: Generate product images for all 50 Gorilla Tag cosmetic items currently defined in the backend, matching each item's name and visual description

quotes: For every cosmetic find a photo of them online and put it underneath them in the space provided

acceptanceCriteria: Each of the 50 cosmetic items has a corresponding product image
All images are visually consistent in style and dimensions

requirements.text: Update the CosmeticItem component to display the generated product image below the item name in the designated space, replacing the sparkles icon placeholder

quotes: put it underneath them in the space provided

acceptanceCriteria: Product images render below the cosmetic item name
Images are properly sized and styled to fit the card layout
Fallback handling exists if an image fails to load

constraints: Images must be stored in frontend/public/assets/generated as static assets
Do not route images through the backend
Maintain the existing warm coral/peach/rose gold visual theme
nonGoals: Changing the cosmetic item data structure in the backend
Modifying the pricing or purchase logic
Altering the overall layout of the shop grid
